data.name: Jyothsna
data.gender_notes: Jyothsna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jyothsna is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jyot’, meaning ‘light’ or ‘knowledge’. The suffix ‘sna’ denotes a female form, making Jyothsna the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge in Hindu mythology. The name Jyothsna carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jyothsna usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and knowledge, guiding one through the labyrinth of life.
